text: In February 2022, a request was filed to remove Nic Stone's Dear Martin from South Garner High School; the school committee decided to continue using it as supplemental material in English I classes. Parents challenged its use in the “culture and identity” unit of Rockwood School District’s ninth grade English classes in St. Louis County, MO. The Monett School District in Monett, Mo., removed it from lesson plans, and Columbia County Schools in Columbia County, GA, pulled it from its recommended reading list.
meta_description: Dear Martin by Nic Stone: a February 2022 removal request at South Garner High School was declined; removed from lesson plans in Monett.
